string.value: Snowdrop Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A coin-shaped snowdrop. You can purchase items from Inkwell with these coins.

string.name: name
string.value: Gallant Emblem

string.name: desc
string.value: An emblem gifted by the god of war. An unknown power radiates from it.

string.name: name
string.value: Red Button

string.name: desc
string.value: A red button. These can be used to purchase items from Inkwell.

string.name: name
string.value: Crusader Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: The currency used within the Silent Crusade. Available supplies are determined by your rank.

string.name: name
string.value: Tourist Memorial Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A memorial coin distributed to the tourists of Maple World. Collecting these coins will come in handy later on.

string.name: name
string.value: Monster Park Commemorative Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A special coin to commemorate the Monster Park. Take it to Spiegelmann at the Monster Park to trade it for a special item.

string.name: name
string.value: Dolphin Island Commemorative Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A commemorative coin given to visitors to Dolphin Island. The back of the coin features Pason's signature.\n#cGather up 4 and bring them to Pason to trade them for a Traveling Pouch.#

string.name: name
string.value: Cherry Blossom Commemorative Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A commemorative coin given to those who visit the cherry blossoms. The back of the coin features the signature of Chief Stan.\n#cGather up 4 and bring them to Chief Stan to trade them for a Traveling Pouch.#

string.name: name
string.value: Treasure Hunt 'You Lose' Note

string.name: desc
string.value: A treasure hunt note featuring a picture of a bomb. That probably means it's no good.\n#cGather up the 'You Lose' notes and bring them to Hooper, the merchant, to trade them for food items.#

string.name: name
string.value: 7th Anniversary Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A coin to commemorate MapleStory's 7th Anniversary. You can only find these during the 7th Anniversary celebration. You can use them to buy Joy Bird Feathers, which Inkwell can then use to upgrade Maple Beryl equipment into Crimson Maple equipment.

string.name: name
string.value: Legends Awards Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A coin used during the Legends Awards. Can be used to purchase various useful items in the Legends Shop.

string.name: name
string.value: Legends Maple Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A special currency used during the Legends event. You can use it from the Maple Tab in the Legends Shop.

string.name: name
string.value: Crusader Coins

string.name: desc
string.value: A special coin used to buy Silent Crusade items.

string.name: name
string.value: Homecoming Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A special sporty coin that can be exchanged for equipment and scrolls from Inkwell.

string.name: name
string.value: Legends Awards Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A coin that can be obtained by participating in various Maple Award events. You can trade it for items at the Award Shop by opening the UI on the left side of the screen.

string.name: name
string.value: Renegades Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: A coin used during the Renegades Festival. Can be used to purchase various useful items in the Renegades Shop.

string.name: name
string.value: Conqueror's Coin

string.name: desc
string.value: Coin obtained by clearing Fight for Azwan. Used to purchase rare Azwan items.
